text.en:
Energy Weapons are refunded 1 Ammo upon hitting Matching Elemental Shields.

Upon breaking a Combatant, Barrier, or Guardian Shield: <title Refills [G_refill] /> magazine.

enhanced (
#e Passively grants +5 Handling.
)
text.zh-chs:
打破战斗人员、勇士、或守护者的护盾时：<title 重新装填 [G_refill] />弹匣。

若能量武器与战斗护盾元素类型吻合，击中目标时可重生弹药。

enhanced (
#e 被动提升 +5 操控性。
)
